Talent0_2Ability.name: Helmswoman
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When using rockets to actively attack, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> enemy hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4010500>[Intelligence]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>25</color> stacks. Rockets weights are reduced by <color=#F74848>130</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Helmswoman
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When using rockets to actively attack, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> enemy hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4010500>[Intelligence]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>25</color> stacks. Rockets weights are reduced by <color=#F74848>130</color>.
At the start of battle, obtains <color=#F74848>10</color> stacks of <buf ID=4010500>[Intelligence]</buf>

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700024.name: Graphite Warhead
700024.describe: Uses Rocket Launcher to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3*3 tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG. After combat, inflict <buf ID=3006502>[Short Circuit I]</buf> on the targets hit, effective <color=#F74848>1</color> time.

401002.name: Know your enemies
401002.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, if the number of <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf> stacks are less than <color=#F74848>10</color>, no stacks will be consumed

401003.name: Planning
401003.describe: Completely refills Rocket Launchers ammo Magazine and gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf>. Can continue action with remaining movement.

401004.name: Tactical Command
401004.describe: Choose <color=#F74848>1</color> skill to switch to from <skill activeSkill=4010041>[Strike Tactic]</skill>, <skill activeSkill=4010042>[Maneuver Tactic]</skill> or <skill activeSkill=4010043>[All-out Tactic]</skill>.

401005.name: Advanced Warhead
401005.SpecificEffects: When attacking with Rocket Launcher, grants <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff to allies within the attack AOE, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

401006.name: Mass Boming
401006.describe: Consume <color=#F74848>2</color> rounds of ammo, use Rocket Launchers to attack all enemies within <range type=1>5×5 grid</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25</color> AOE DMG. After combat, grants all allies color=#F74848>1</color> random buff, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

401007.name: Intelligence Advantage
401007.SpecificEffects: When possessing <color=#F74848>20</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf>, reduces allies AOE DMG taken by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. After combat grants <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff to those allies, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

401008.name: Selective Bombing
401008.describe: Use two Rocket Launchers to attack all enemies within <range type=1>5×5 grid</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>2×0.15</color> AOE DMG. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, grants all allies <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4010082>[Surprise Attack Tactic]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks. Each attack can only obtain a maximum of <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

401041.name: Flawless Calculation 1
401041.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, additionally gains <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf>.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401044.name: Flawless Calculation 2
401044.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf> effect changes to: increases all allies DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>1.2%</color>. <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks are consumed when attacking.

401045.name: Flawless Calculation 3
401045.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf> stacks are <color=#F74848>20</color> or more, AP recovery increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

401046.name: Flawless Calculation 4
401046.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf> maximum stacks increase to <color=#F74848>35</color>, and <buf ID=900123>[Intelligence]</buf> effect is increased by <color=#F74848>75%</color>.
